en.headline: Siobhan Haughey takes Asian Games 50m freestyle silver
en.dek: The Hong Kong swimmer clocked 24.32 seconds for silver behind China’s Wu Qingfeng, who set a Games record, adding a third individual medal this campaign.
body: Siobhan Haughey won silver in the women’s 50-metre freestyle at the Asian Games in Nagoya on Thursday, finishing in 24.32 seconds.

China’s Wu Qingfeng claimed gold in a Games-record 23.98 seconds, while teammate Cheng Yujie took bronze. Haughey, the defending silver medallist from the previous Games, had qualified second-fastest from the heats.
The result is Haughey’s third individual medal of the 2026 Asian Games, following her gold in the 100-metre freestyle earlier in the week. Reaction time in the final was recorded at 0.67 seconds.

zh.headline: 何詩蓓亞運女子50米自由泳摘銀
zh.dek: 港隊泳手何詩蓓以24秒32奪得銀牌，國家隊吳卿風以破亞運紀錄的23秒98奪金，這是她今屆亞運第三面個人獎牌。
body: 名古屋亞運女子50米自由泳決賽，港隊泳手何詩蓓造出24秒32，取得銀牌。
金牌由國家隊泳手吳卿風以破亞運紀錄的23秒98奪得，銅牌亦由國家隊程玉潔取得。何詩蓓初賽以總成績第二名晉級，決賽反應時間為0.67秒。
這是何詩蓓今屆亞運第三面個人獎牌，早前她已在女子100米自由泳奪金。
